character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A burly, grey-haired barkeep in a side-profile view, standing with feet firmly planted. He wears a thick, worn leather apron over a beige linen shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbows. A heavy leather belt with a hanging pouch cinches his waist. His arms are crossed firmly over a broad chest, his expression a mix of stern focus and welcoming warmth. The color palette features earthy browns, muted greys, and warm parchment tones, defined by crisp black outlines.
